topic: Chen and Chen's even-row parity-positivity conjectures for the step-m Eulerian triangle
title: Proof of Chen and Chen's parity-positivity conjectures: OEIS A392664–A392666, COMMENTS, and Conjecture 2 (p. 1)

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Conjecture 2 on page 1 of Chen and Chen's January 2026 executive summary and the parity-positivity conjectures in OEIS A392664–A392666, COMMENTS: every positive even row is strictly positive for real m <= -3. We also prove the odd-row alternating-sum nonvanishing assertions at m = -4 and -5. The largest root modulus satisfies M_n(-3) ~ 5^(n/2)/sqrt(45), correcting the stated exponent log(2) to log(5)/2 and the proposed scaling constant 1/3. The constants 1/6 and 1/10 at steps -4 and -5 are proved. Companion identities, the integer-step sign classification and boundary cases have written proofs.
summary: Written proofs cover real-parameter even-row positivity, odd-row signs and nonvanishing, exact root asymptotics for m > 0, m = -3 and m <= -4, degenerate-step factorizations and the integer sign classification. Exact finite checks cover 14 integer steps through row 400, degenerate steps through row 400 and six rational steps through row 60.
